column2: a loud thunderclap echoes through the jungle
column3: startling the wildlife and causing the jaguar to flee deeper into the forest. Xander prepares his camera
column4: ready to wait patiently in the clearing for the jaguar to appear.;Does Xander believe the clearing is a perfect spot for observing the jaguar or that it is now empty due to the thunderclap?;Xander believes the clearing is a perfect spot for observing the jaguar.;Xander believes the clearing is now empty due to the thunderclap.

column2: glistening in the dappled sunlight. Cedric believes the feather belongs to a Resplendent Quetzal
column3: indicating the bird's nearby presence. Suddenly
column4: a troop of monkeys swings through the trees
column5: sending the feather tumbling into a nearby stream
column6: where it gets soaked and loses its luster. Cedric prepares to photograph the feather as evidence of the bird's presence.;Does Cedric believe the feather belongs to a Resplendent Quetzal or that it has been soaked and lost its luster?;Cedric believes the feather belongs to a Resplendent Quetzal.;Cedric believes the feather has been soaked and lost its luster.

column1: Imani is a wildlife photographer on a safari in the Serengeti. Imani wants to capture stunning images of lions during the golden hour. She spots a pride of lions lounging under a tree
column2: basking in the warm sunlight. Imani believes the lions are relaxed and will remain in that position for a while. Suddenly
column3: a loud thunderclap startles the lions
column4: causing them to stand up and move swiftly into the tall grass. Imani sets up her camera to capture the lions in their relaxed state.;Does Imani believe the lions are relaxed and will remain in that position
column5: or does she now know they have moved into the tall grass?;Imani believes the lions are relaxed and will remain in that position.;Imani believes the lions have moved swiftly into the tall grass.
